Each row pairs a human name with the service base_url to pass as the first argument of the fhir_patients / fhir_observations / fhir_search / fhir_read / fhir_capabilities table functions, the FHIR version served, whether the endpoint needs authentication, and a short description. rows.vgi.doc_md:
## fhir_servers

A curated, credential-free directory of well-known **public HL7 FHIR R4** endpoints. It is a static list (no network access), so it always returns instantly and is the natural starting point for discovery: pick a `base_url` here and hand it to any `fhir_*` table function as its first argument.

### Columns

- `name` — human-friendly server name.
- `base_url` — the FHIR R4 service base URL (e.g. `https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4`).
- `fhir_version` — the FHIR version served (all `4.0.1`).
- `requires_auth` — whether an OAuth bearer token is needed (all listed servers are open).
- `description` — what the endpoint is and what data it holds.
rows.vgi.example_queries: [{"description":"List the curated public FHIR R4 test servers and whether each needs authentication.","sql":"SELECT name, base_url, requires_auth FROM fhir.main.fhir_servers ORDER BY name"}]
rows.vgi.title: Public FHIR Servers

rows: CREATE VIEW fhir_servers AS SELECT "name", base_url, fhir_version, requires_auth, description FROM (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('HAPI FHIR R4 Public Test Server', 'https://hapi.fhir.org/baseR4', '4.0.1', false, 'Open, unauthenticated public HAPI reference server hosting a large shared R4 dataset; ideal for exploration and demos.'), ('Firely Public FHIR R4 Server', 'https://server.fire.ly', '4.0.1', false, 'Firely public FHIR R4 test server (no authentication); a useful second endpoint for cross-server checks.'), ('SMART Health IT R4 Sandbox', 'https://r4.smarthealthit.org', '4.0.1', false, 'SMART Health IT open R4 sandbox seeded with synthetic Synthea patient data.'), ('HL7 Terminology Server (R4)', 'https://tx.fhir.org/r4', '4.0.1', false, 'HL7 public R4 terminology server exposing CodeSystem, ValueSet, and related conformance resources.')) AS valueslist) AS t("name", base_url, fhir_version, requires_auth, description);
